```plato

//==
// # Tori
//
// The ring solid swept by a disk around a circle. A solid denotes the filled region
// including its boundary surface; the axis is a unit direction.

// A solid torus: all points within MinorRadius of the circle of MajorRadius
// about Center in the plane perpendicular to Axis. Self-intersecting when
// MinorRadius exceeds MajorRadius. (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Torus)
type Torus
    implements IGeometry3D, IClosedShape, IConnected, IVolume, IBounded3D, ICentroid3D, IContainsPoint3D, IParametricSurface
{
    Center: Point3D;
    Axis: Direction3D;
    MajorRadius: Number;
    MinorRadius: Number;
}
```
